_meta.definition: Unified management of call center operations and inventory levels

ship_mode._description: Tracks various shipping modes (e.g., air, sea) and their associated details for order deliveries in the TPC-DS database.

columns.name: sm_ship_mode_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for shipment modes (1, 2, 3, 4, 5).

columns.name: sm_ship_mode_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the sm_ship_mode_ entity

columns.name: sm_type
columns.description: Stores transportation mode types such as EXPRESS, NEXT DAY, OVERNIGHT, TWO DAY, LIBRARY.

columns.name: sm_code
columns.description: Stores a 10-character alphabetic code representing air transport modes.

columns.name: sm_carrier
columns.description: Stores names of carriers for shipments (e.g., UPS, FEDEX, USPS, DHL).

columns.name: sm_contract
columns.description: Stores unique alphanumeric identifiers for ship mode contracts.
